body.title: Admit verified test evidence through investigation navigation
body.reproduction: Run `/home/subho/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.1/bin/node --import tsx /tmp/reproduce-s6-test-inspection-gap.mts`. The deterministic fixture supplies a daemon-verified passing test-result receipt bound to the active attempt and pinned BUILD source. S2 evidenceFromReceipt accepts it, but InvestigationNavigation.read rejects the same inspection with `Read is not the authenticated inspected receipt.` Expected: verified test evidence reaches the existing ledger admission path and can support test obligations; source provenance checks remain strict. Reproduction output is in /tmp/s6-test-inspection-gap.log. No model call or source mutation is needed. [c1,c2,c3]
body.rootCause: InvestigationNavigation.read applies the source-read receipt equality check to every inspection kind. In contrast, evidenceFromReceipt intentionally requires readReceipt:null for test-result receipts, along with a pinned source commit and explicit actual result. A non-null read returned to the reviewer therefore cannot equal the valid test inspection's null readReceipt. The source and verified-test receipt forms are both individually valid but their integration is incompatible. This S3-owned defect blocks S6 t3 production test-evidence integration. [c1,c2]
body.fixIntent: Allow actual daemon-verified test inspections through the existing authenticated navigation and S2 evidence admission path, with read/result metadata bound to the same pinned source and active attempt. Preserve source-read equality, cancellation/ownership checks, receipt identity and all S2 provenance/result checks; unsupported or forged kinds/results must still refuse. Add focused regression coverage for valid passing/failed/unknown results, mismatched or unverified metadata, wrong attempt/source, and unchanged source-read behavior. Do not change shared interface shapes, S4 journal formats, review severity, coverage obligations or automatic completion. Resume the already approved S6 plan after this prerequisite is completed. [c1,c2,c3]
